generation_review.prompt:
Draw exactly ONE new original Small Seal glyph using the attached four-specimen Unicode reference. The four labelled samples THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC all show ONE character. Study every AVAILABLE view equally, including small stroke junctions, bar lengths, counters and separate legs. An UNAVAILABLE blank is not evidence. Choose a coherent attested whole structure where sources vary; never mix incompatible alternatives, privilege THX, trace a single brush silhouette or substitute a modern Chinese character.

Create genuine, clean, smooth pen trajectories: BLACK strokes with the SAME CONSTANT WIDTH everywhere, approximately3% of the full square canvas. Shape only their centerline paths; no swelling, brush contrast, taper, pointed ends, roughness, texture, serifs, shadows or decoration. Roundcaps and smoothly rounded joins; controlled curves, generous open channels and counters. Preserve exact stroke inventory, meaningful short/long bar relationships, detachments and attachments.

Only ONE glyph centered in the central70% of a square TRANSPARENT canvas, ample margin. No labels, names, codepoints, text, numbers, reference copies, multiple variants, grid, background or border. The following explicit structural reading aid clarifies the character; it remains subordinate to all four historical specimens.

U+3D05F reading aid:
1. Top group contains TWO separate six-ray figures side by side. Each has one continuous central vertical extending above and below its crossing node, one upward-open U with two rising arms, and one downward-open arch with two descending arms. Thus SIX free ends per figure: three up, three down. Twelve upper-group free ends total.
2. These are six-ray figures, not two U shapes stacked upward and not boxes. Each has exactly one central shared crossing node, no counter and no additional horizontal crossbar.
3. Keep the two top figures independent and a clear open gap between them. All six lower ends in the top group finish above the separate short separator bar with visible white gaps, following the coherent THX/CCZ/DYC whole construction. Consider QJZ's nearby/right-stalk contact variant without mixing it into this detached choice.
4. Below the two figures place a detached SHORT horizontal separator. Below it place a second LONGER horizontal crossbar. The long lower bar is widest in the glyph; the short separator is shorter than the combined top pair width, about two-thirds of the lower bar.
5. From lower long crossbar midpoint descends one central straight leg attached to that bar. Two long gently outward-curved flank legs start below the bar with clear gaps. Exactly THREE bottom legs, all ending separately; central may finish slightly lower. Do not attach upper rays to lower bars and do not add a third upper figure.
